g.aria-label: Why High-Noise Guidance Breaks the Gaussian Curvature Ceiling
Blurred p_t = p₀ * N(0, σ_t² I) Obeys −∇²log p_t ⪯ (1/σ_t²) I
Convolving with variance σ_t² bounds precision above by 1 / σ_t²
For γ > S²/(S² − s²) = 8/7, Precision Exceeds 1/t² Near t = 1
At γ = 4, guided score violates the ceiling across all t ∈ (0.24, 1]!
Apply γ > 1 only in mid-noise band, or guide against a weaker net
Disabling guidance at high noise (t → 1) prevents violent early variance contraction
